A male voice. Accent: generic American, young, wheedling. Chester, Mrs. Albright's nephew, always short of money.
Natural, conversational telephone speech, 1950s.
sample_text: Operator, room 302, please. Mrs. Edith Albright. I'm her nephew. Aunt Edith! It's Chester! I'm down in the lobby. What a coincidence.
